text.p: Winnipeg Commodity Exchange canola and grain futures pre-opening call as of 0830 CDT.
CANOLA - C$1.00 to C$1.50 a tonne higher on an expected local short covering rally as the CBOT soycomplex was called higher. But gains should be curbed by good Prairie growing weather.
November WCE futures crush margin fell to -5.79 Monday from -0.66 Friday.

There was talk of light exporter buying overnight and crushers were seen resuming buying August and November futures. Canada's dollar opened down at C$1.3792 to the U.S. dollar, fell to 81.65 yen, rose to 1.2740 marks.
FLAXSEED - C$0.50 to C$1.00 up on spill over support except in July which will likely be higher due to tight old crop stocks.
WESTERN BARLEY - Steady to C$0.50 higher on continued local short covering with gains capped by farmer hedges.
FEED WHEAT - Steady to C$0.50 up on spill over support.
PEAS - Steady to US$0.50 higher on CBOT soymeal calls.
OATS - Steady to US$1.00 up on expected commercial demand.
(All values in Canadian dollars/tonne except peas, oats)
